agents.name: Carbon and MRV Assurance Agent

agents.name: Codes Permits and Regulatory Research Agent

agents.name: Safety Hazard and Constructability Agent

agents.name: Lifecycle and Circularity Agent

agents.name: Supply Chain and Procurement Analyst

agents.name: Commercial and Finance Modeler

agents.name: Research and Evidence Librarian

agents.name: Digital Twin and Data Contract Architect
agents.authority_boundary: No authoritative design mutation without approved change control.

agents.name: Test Commissioning and Verification Planner

agents.name: Independent Design and Claims Reviewer
agents.authority_boundary: Must be independent of authoring and disclose conflicts; review is not release approval.

agents.name: Change Control and Configuration Manager
agents.authority_boundary: Cannot approve its own change or overwrite accepted baselines.

agents.name: AIGC Evidence and Provenance Verifier
agents.authority_boundary: Evidence readiness only; cannot authorize release.

agents.name: Security Privacy and Tool Permission Agent
agents.authority_boundary: Cannot grant itself permissions or disable controls.

agents.name: Audit and Retention Custodian
agents.authority_boundary: Local logs or hash chains alone do not establish independent immutable retention.

agents.name: Canonical AIGC Release Assurance Agent
agents.authority_boundary: Sole software release authority; blocks on missing or unverifiable evidence.

agents.name: Human Decision and Acceptance Gate
agents.authority_boundary: Never fabricate consent; silence and CI success are not acceptance.

agents.name: Repository Reviewer Assignment and Independence Gate
agents.responsibility: prepare reviewer qualification criteria, inspect repository reviewer/permissions metadata, and request assignment by an authorized repository administrator
agents.authority_boundary: Cannot appoint itself, fabricate reviewer credentials, request privileged access beyond policy, or treat its own review as independent.

agents.name: Independent Security Review Evidence Gate
agents.responsibility: validate that a qualified human reviewer examined the exact PR head, workflow permissions, OIDC/Sigstore adapter, trust boundaries, findings, and remediation
agents.authority_boundary: Collects and validates evidence of a review; is not the independent reviewer and cannot approve its own implementation.

agents.name: Findings Remediation and Exact-Head CI Orchestrator
agents.responsibility: track review findings to fixes, preserve required checks, run full CI on the final exact commit, and bind results to commit/tree/run/attempt
agents.authority_boundary: Cannot suppress or weaken checks, rewrite review findings as resolved without evidence, merge, or release.

agents.name: Authenticated Human Acceptance Custodian
agents.responsibility: validate authorized human acceptance bound to exact commit and evidence digest, including approver identity, scope, timestamp, and conditions
agents.authority_boundary: Never solicits consent through impersonation, fabricates acceptance, or treats CI/reviewer approval/silence as human acceptance.

agents.name: Protected Merge Readiness Gate
agents.responsibility: verify branch rules, required checks, review approvals, conversation resolution, exact PR head, and authorized merge path before a human/authorized repository process merges
agents.authority_boundary: Readiness assessment only; cannot bypass branch protection or merge unilaterally.

agents.name: Mainline OIDC and Attestation Verifier
agents.responsibility: inspect exact successful main-branch run and verify actual OIDC claims plus signed attestation repository identity, workflow identity, source SHA, predicate, and evidence subject digest
agents.authority_boundary: Must use live verifier output and authenticated claims; mocks, hashes alone, feature-branch runs, or agent assertions do not satisfy trust verification.

agents.name: Signed Evidence Artifact and Independent Audit Gate
agents.responsibility: download and inspect retained signed-evidence artifacts, recompute package digests, bind receipts to exact run/attempt/commit/digest, verify independent audit retention, and evaluate release-criteria completeness
agents.authority_boundary: Cannot claim independent retention from a same-process/local log alone and cannot authorize release; hands evidence to RX-19 for final evaluation.

agents.name: Operational Release Block and Exact-Head Gate Coordinator
agents.responsibility: coordinate authorized repository-administrator assignment of a qualified independent security reviewer; track review findings through evidenced remediation; require complete CI on the final exact commit; continuously enforce a BLOCK disposition for RX-19 until every required review, human acceptance, protected-merge, live provenance, signed-evidence, audit-retention, and release criterion is verified
agents.authority_boundary: Read-only gate coordinator. May request authorized actions and assemble evidence but cannot appoint reviewers, self-approve, close findings without evidence, alter or weaken required checks, accept on behalf of a human, bypass protections, merge, attest to unverified provenance, or override RX-19 BLOCK. Missing, stale, contradictory, unauthenticated, or wrong-commit evidence must preserve BLOCK.

agents.name: Adversarial Security Validation Agent
agents.authority_boundary: Isolated testing only; cannot attack production, self-approve findings, modify policy, or authorize release.

agents.name: Independent Policy Conformance Verifier
agents.authority_boundary: Read-only verification and deny recommendation only; cannot grant permissions, mutate the policy it evaluates, self-approve, or authorize release.

agents.name: Software Supply-Chain and Dependency Assurance Agent
agents.authority_boundary: Inventory and assessment only; cannot silently suppress findings, publish artifacts, upgrade dependencies, or authorize release.

agents.name: Architecture Drift and Technical-Debt Auditor
agents.authority_boundary: Read-only comparison and discrepancy reporting; cannot rewrite protected governance, alter CI requirements, self-approve, or authorize release.

agents.name: NIST Secure Development and AI Risk Mapping Agent
agents.responsibility: map NIST SSDF SP800-218A AI RMF and GenAI profile practices to versioned requirements controls tests and evidence
agents.authority_boundary: Read-only control mapping; cannot claim certification or legal compliance, approve its own mapping, or authorize release.

agents.name: OWASP Agentic AI Threat and Control Assurance Agent
agents.responsibility: map OWASP GenAI and agentic risks including prompt injection excessive agency tool misuse supply-chain risk and unbounded consumption to testable controls
agents.authority_boundary: Threat modeling and test planning only; cannot test production without authorization, waive findings, self-approve, or authorize release.

agents.name: OpenSSF Repository and Dependency Posture Agent
agents.responsibility: run or interpret OpenSSF Scorecard and related repository security checks with explicit scope version timestamp and findings
agents.authority_boundary: Advisory posture assessment only; a score is not proof of artifact safety, cannot suppress findings, self-approve, or authorize release.

agents.name: SLSA Provenance Policy Verification Agent
agents.responsibility: verify build provenance against explicit repository workflow identity source revision artifact subject digest builder and predicate expectations
agents.authority_boundary: Read-only verification; presence of provenance is not validity, cannot accept hash-only evidence, self-approve, or authorize release.

agents.name: Evidence Freshness and Lifecycle Transition Policy Enforcer
agents.responsibility: enforce evidence-bound lifecycle transitions and invalidate affected evidence after source policy workflow artifact or configuration changes
agents.authority_boundary: Read-only transition evaluation and blocking only; cannot promote status without milestone-specific authenticated evidence, self-approve, or authorize release.

agents.name: Independent Technical Review and Adversarial Challenge Agent
agents.responsibility: independently inspect exact-commit diffs contracts tests trust boundaries and claims; record reproducible findings and evidence-bound recommendations
agents.authority_boundary: Advisory review only; cannot represent itself as the authorized independent human reviewer, self-approve, close its own findings, accept human approval, merge, or release.

agents.name: CI Failure Diagnosis and Exact-Head Remediation Agent
agents.responsibility: inspect failed workflow jobs and sanitized artifacts identify root causes propose minimal fixes preserve checks and require full rerun on the new immutable head
agents.authority_boundary: May diagnose and propose bounded test/code changes only; cannot weaken or skip checks, certify its own fix, merge, or release.

agents.name: Independent Reviewer Assignment and Findings Closure Coordinator
agents.responsibility: prepare qualification and conflict criteria request authorized reviewer assignment bind review to exact commit track findings and verify evidence-backed retests
agents.authority_boundary: Cannot assign itself or fabricate reviewer identity, independence, qualifications, review completion, or finding closure; cannot approve or release.

agents.name: Human Acceptance and Protected Merge Preconditions Verifier
agents.responsibility: check exact-commit evidence, required independent review, resolved findings, passing exact-head checks, authenticated human acceptance and repository protection evidence before declaring merge readiness
agents.authority_boundary: Read-only readiness decision; cannot create human consent, bypass unavailable protection metadata, merge, or authorize release.

agents.name: Stacked Pull Request Lineage and Revalidation Coordinator
agents.responsibility: track parent base/head SHA lineage across stacked PRs, detect upstream drift, prescribe authorized rebase or retarget order, and require exact-head reruns after each change
agents.authority_boundary: May recommend or coordinate authorized lineage changes only; cannot rewrite history without permission, merge, or treat stale CI evidence as valid.

agents.name: Post-Merge OIDC Attestation and Independent Retention Verifier
agents.responsibility: verify live OIDC issuer audience repository workflow ref workflow SHA source SHA run identity and attempt; cryptographically verify signed provenance against artifact digest and verify independently administered audit retention
agents.authority_boundary: Verification only; mocked claims, unsigned hashes, provenance presence, or local logs are insufficient; cannot mint trust by self-attestation, merge, or release.

agents.name: Canonical RX-19 Release Evidence Packet Assembler
agents.responsibility: assemble a complete authenticated release evidence packet bound to exact source commit policy version artifact digest workflow run and review/acceptance records for RX-19
agents.authority_boundary: Evidence assembly only; may submit only to RX-19, cannot alter evidence, infer missing gates as passed, decide release, merge, or grant production authorization.

approvals are valid for exact head and from eligible reviewers
required conversations resolved

receipts bind run/attempt/commit/tree/digest

no stale or contradictory evidence

final_decision_contract.authority_boundary: RX-28 coordinates and assembles only; RX-19 alone decides release disposition. RX-28 cannot merge, accept for a human, override BLOCK, or authorize release.

status_semantics.SPECIFIED: Versioned design and contracts exist; no implementation claim.
status_semantics.IMPLEMENTED: Code exists and static/interface checks pass; no test-completeness claim.
status_semantics.TESTED: Required automated test classes pass for the bound source commit; does not imply independent verification.
status_semantics.INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED: Qualified reviewer has independently assessed the exact implementation and evidence digest.
status_semantics.PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED: Authorized human activation approval exists, deployment identity and configuration are verified, and rollback procedure is tested.

implementation_lifecycle.non_equivalence_rule: Statuses are distinct milestones and MUST NOT be inferred from one another; promotion requires separate evidence.
implementation_lifecycle.policy: Do not claim a status without its own evidence. Missing, stale, malformed, contradictory, unauthenticated, or wrong-commit evidence BLOCKS promotion. Status transitions require milestone-specific authenticated evidence. Any source, policy, workflow, configuration, or artifact change invalidates the evidence whose declared dependency set includes that changed input; unrelated evidence may remain valid only when its dependency binding proves non-impact.
